Class CoastlineData

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.widgets.map.CoastlineData
public final class CoastlineData extends Object
A set of coastline polylines used by CoastlineShape, LandShape and the WorldMap land tint.

The bundled() data is Natural Earth 1:50m, loaded once from a classpath resource with only JDK APIs (native-image packaging must include that resource). To show finer or custom geography without bloating the jar, supply your own via of(double[][]) — for example a higher-resolution Natural Earth export converted to coordinates. Each line is a flat array of longitude/latitude pairs in degrees, longitude first.
